summary: @servicetitan/marketing-direct-mail-components 20.1.2 ships preinstall dropper executing obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun runtime
details: Version 20.1.2 of this React component library adds a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, and uses `execFileSync` to run a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js` under Bun. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0x0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}` plus a large numeric constant array), hiding its network destinations and behavior from static inspection. `setup.mjs` itself uses identifier and string mangling. The `dist/` and `src/` trees contain the legitimate ServiceTitan direct-mail UI components consistent with prior releases; the `preinstall`, `setup.mjs`, and `math_init.js` artifacts are unrelated to the UI components, are not referenced by `dist/`, and are not mentioned in CHANGELOG. Running `npm install` on this version fetches and executes an alternate-runtime-delivered opaque payload with the installer's privileges, bypassing Node-based scanning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
